summary: Frontend E2E of new Return to Store feature (Production side) + Pending Store Return (Store side) + regression on renamed Store tabs. All 9 requested scenarios PASSED end-to-end. Full flow verified: My Stock Requests detail modal with correct header/items table/totals + Print button; Return Against Request Step 1 previous-requests list (16 rows for Ankit) + Step 2 issued items with correct math; over-qty validation (server + toast); 'Other' reason reveals+requires Remarks; RTN-000003 created + landed in list as 'Awaiting Store'; Manual Return with autocomplete (products/search), +Add Item / remove row, submit -> RTN-000004 'Manual' with Original Request '—'; Return detail dialog opens with all expected fields + Print; Store side Pending Store Return queue shows both returns; Process opens dialog with verification table (Originally Issued / Already Returned / Current Return) for Against Request type; empty-reason Reject shows 'Rejection reason is required' toast; Reject with reason moves status to Rejected + row leaves pending queue; Production side then shows 'Edit & Resubmit' on rejected row -> reopens flow with qty prefilled -> resubmit resets to 'Awaiting Store'; Confirm Return button verified present, enabled, labeled 'Confirm Return' (NOT clicked per SAP write warning). Store regression tabs (Pending Store Request rename, Journal, Balance Pending, Movement History) all load cleanly with no console errors and existing pending queue still shows 8 real requests.

test_evidence.myreq_detail_modal: Opened P1-000005 -> header shows Request Date/Time '22 Aug, 12:52 pm', Requested By 'Ankit', Site 'P1', Status 'Resolved', Total Items 4. Item table math: 4 rows all Requested==Issued, Pending 0. Totals row: 202/202/0 (matches 100+100+1+1). Print button (data-testid myreq-detail-print-button) present.
test_evidence.against_request_step1: 16 previous stock requests loaded for requester=Ankit via GET /api/store-returns/previous-requests. Pick P1-000005.
test_evidence.against_request_step2: 4 issued items shown with correct Requested/Issued/Already Returned columns matching myreq data. Reason dropdown has 8 options.
test_evidence.over_qty_validation: Return Qty 9,999,999 with reason=Unused Material -> HTTP 400 from server + toast 'Return quantity for P10080B exceeds what's still available to return (100.0)'. Submit blocked.
test_evidence.other_reason_remarks: Selecting 'Other' reveals Remarks input; submit without remarks -> toast 'Remarks are required when reason is Other'; adding remarks succeeds; RTN-000003 created with status Awaiting Store.
test_evidence.manual_return: Site P1 selected; autocomplete for 'FLAT' returned 8 suggestions from /api/products/search; picked 100521-137; +Add Item -> 2 rows; remove -> 1 row; submit -> RTN-000004 landed as Manual / Original Request '—' / Awaiting Store.
test_evidence.return_detail_dialog: return-detail-dialog opened for RTN-000003 showing return type, original request, requester, site, date, items table (Item/Material/Return Qty/UOM/Reason/Remarks/SAP Goods Movement '—'), Print + Close buttons.
test_evidence.store_tab_labels: Order verified: Pending Store Request | Pending Store Return | Journal (All Requests) | Balance Pending | Movement History. data-testids: store-view-mode-queue/returns/journal/balance/movements.
test_evidence.store_pending_returns_process: Process on RTN-000003 opens store-return-process-dialog with 'VERIFY AGAINST ORIGINAL STORE ISSUE' section showing P10080B: Originally Issued 100 EA / Already Returned 0 EA / Current Return 1 EA. Below that, items table with reason/remarks/SAP Goods Movement columns. Status auto-transitions to 'Under Verification' on open (POST /api/store-returns/{id}/process fired).
test_evidence.reject_validation: Reject Return with empty textarea -> toast 'Rejection reason is required'. Return not rejected. With reason typed -> POST succeeds, RTN-000003 status -> Rejected, disappears from pending queue.
test_evidence.edit_resubmit: Production 'Edit & Resubmit' button (data-testid return-edit-resubmit-button-N) appears on rejected row. Click reopens Against Request Step 2 with Return Qty 0-slot prefilled to 1 (original qty). Submit -> RTN-000003 status back to Awaiting Store.
test_evidence.confirm_button: Confirm Return button present, enabled=True, text='Confirm Return'. Not clicked per SAP write warning; behaviour beyond click not tested.
test_evidence.regression_tabs: Journal (All Requests), Balance Pending, Movement History all rendered without console errors. Pending Store Request queue shows 8 real requests (P2-000121, P2-000120, P1-000004, P3-000001, P1-000001, ee51be09..., 83308583..., f15256ff...) - unchanged.

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend passes rejection status detection via return_type field on Edit & Resubmit; only 1 rejected return present at test time so multi-row prefill selector correctness not stress-tested. Consider adding an integration test for the case where multiple rejected returns exist simultaneously.
Print button in Return Detail dialog is not tested for actual print output content (only presence verified). Low priority.

Store process dialog uses POST /api/store-returns/{id}/process on OPEN of the dialog (auto-transition to under_verification). If the store user closes the dialog without acting, the return is left in 'under_verification' state indefinitely, no longer in 'pending' filter. Consider whether Store abandoning the dialog should revert status back to 'pending'.
